title: Connect request
text: Every hosting mode shares the start request. The engine also accepts a hosted-service handoff of a preissued four-character code after organization selection; explicit engine org scope, personal approval and single-use delivery reuse the existing store. Authenticated service polling avoids a shared proxy-address budget without changing public admission. Hosted route adoption and deployed proof remain pending. The approval card groups machine identity, code, org and local expiry with its zone; the UTC instant stays on the time element.
